notice: Compiled from Läkemedelsverket's open-data register (Sök läkemedelsfakta, Sveriges dataportal dataset 140_5467) with curated aliases added by contributors. NOT a clinical reference — verify ATC codes and active substances against authoritative sources (Sök VARA, FASS, Läkemedelsboken) before relying on them. Aliases are former product names (from the Tidigare-läkemedelsnamn column) plus common misspellings, generic names, and alternate brand names added manually to help search find the right medicine. Contributions welcome via PR — see README.
